name: MediaSpark – Organize Your Media Library
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
MediaSpark makes media organization effortless! Create folders, add tags, bulk edit files, and keep your WordPress media library perfectly organized.

🌟 Key Features (Free)

  • 📁 Media Folders – Hierarchical folder structure for organizing media
  • 🏷️ Media Tags – Tag-based categorization for easy filtering
  • ⚡ Auto Alt Text – Automatically add SEO-friendly alt text on upload
  • 🏷️ Auto Tags – Automatically tag media based on filename
  • ✏️ Bulk Editing – Assign folders, tags, and alt text to multiple files at once
  • 📊 Analytics Dashboard – See total, used, and unused media at a glance
  • 🔍 Quick Search – Find media files instantly by name
  • 🎨 Beautiful Interface – Modern, intuitive dashboard
  • ⚙️ Easy Settings – Simple configuration for auto features
  • 🆓 100% Free – Core features completely free forever

What Can You Do?

Organize with Folders:
* Create unlimited hierarchical folders
* Move media files between folders
* Filter media library by folder
* Bulk assign multiple files to folders

Tag Your Media:
* Add unlimited tags to media files
* Filter by tags in media library
* Auto-tag based on filename
* Bulk assign tags to multiple files

Bulk Edit Everything:
* Assign multiple files to folders
* Add tags to multiple files at once
* Set alt text from title in bulk
* Set custom alt text for multiple files

Auto Features:
* Auto-add alt text on upload (SEO boost!)
* Auto-add tags from filename
* Configure in settings

Track Your Media:
* See total media count
* View used vs unused media
* Count folders and tags
* Quick search functionality

⭐ Pro Features

Upgrade to MediaSpark Pro for advanced features:

  • 🖼️ Image Watermarking – Add text or image watermarks
  • 🗜️ Bulk Compression – Reduce file sizes automatically
  • ⚡ Lazy Loading – Faster page loads
  • 📊 Advanced Analytics – Usage tracking & insights
  • 🎨 Image Editing – Crop, resize, rotate images
  • 🔄 Auto-Optimize – Optimize images on upload
  • 💬 Priority Support – 24-hour email response
  • 🚀 Lifetime Updates – One-time payment, use forever

View Pro Features & Pricing →
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “MediaSpark”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Go to Media → MediaSpark to see your dashboard
  5. Create folders via Media → Media Folders
  6. Add tags via Media → Media Tags
  7. Use bulk actions in Media Library!
sections.faq:
How do I use bulk actions?

In your Media Library, select multiple files using checkboxes. Choose a MediaSpark action from the “Bulk Actions” dropdown:

  • MediaSpark: Assign to Folder – Opens a page where you can select/create a folder
  • MediaSpark: Assign Tags – Opens a page where you can select/create tags
  • MediaSpark: Set Alt Text from Title – Instantly sets alt text (no confirmation needed)
  • MediaSpark: Set Custom Alt Text – Opens a page to enter custom alt text

How do I assign files to a folder?

Two ways:

  1. Single file: Edit the media file and select a folder from the “Media Folders” box
  2. Multiple files: Select files in Media Library → Bulk Actions → “MediaSpark: Assign to Folder”

Can I create new folders during bulk assign?

Yes! When you use “MediaSpark: Assign to Folder”, you can either:
* Select an existing folder from the dropdown
* Enter a new folder name in the “Or Create New Folder” field

How do bulk tags work?

Same as folders! Select files → Bulk Actions → “MediaSpark: Assign Tags” → Select existing or create new tags.

What’s the difference between the two alt text bulk actions?

  • Set Alt Text from Title – Automatically uses the first 2 words from the filename (instant, no confirmation)
  • Set Custom Alt Text – Opens a page where you can type custom alt text (same for all selected files)
